message: Hope you are doing well? I want to place an order.
I would like to place an order for [item] in [color]. Please confirm the total cost and I will pay.
Hello, I would like to negotiate the price. The quoted amount is above my budget. Can you do [amount]?
Oga, my budget no reach your price. Last price na. Make I know.
Hi! Saw your TikTok video. Can I get the [item]? Also can you ship to [state]?
Hi! I love the dress. I want it in [color] size [size]. When can it get to me?
Please kindly confirm you can dispatch the order today. I will pay extra for same-day dispatch.
You dey scam person? See the price wey you post vs wetin you dey charge now.
Wetin you dey wait for? I dey ready to pay since morning o.
I am calling to ask about the price of the [item] advertised. Please send the catalogue.
I am a student. You get student discount for the [item]? I wan buy today.
I am placing the order for my office. 10 units. Please send bulk discount and total.
Wetin be your cheapest? Na just small money I get.
I no wan rush you. Just send the catalog make I think am.
Oga, the money don enter, the goods no reach. Wetin you dey do? I need am sharp sharp.
Oga, I want am now now. How much you go give me? Just close the deal sharp.
My guy say make I check your store first. Wetin you dey sell?
Please kindly share your business registration and CAC documents. I need to verify before any payment.
Please kindly confirm the [item] is in stock. I will make the transfer once confirmed.
Just confirming - I want the [item] but I am not sure of my size. Can you send size chart?
Oga, why your price higher than the other person wey dey sell same thing?
Will the price be the same if I pay cash vs transfer? Just want to confirm.
I saw your ad on Instagram. Kindly send the price list and available sizes.
How much for the complete set? If I buy all today, any free delivery?
Oga, you no fit deliver am to [area] before 5pm today? If you no fit, no worry.
Quick one - I want to order 3 of the [item]. Total cost with delivery please.
If I pay now, when you go deliver? Tomorrow?
I dey outside the country. Can you deliver to my brother in [city]? He go pay on my behalf.
Abeg I wan ask, the [item] na first come first serve? Make I pay now to hold one.
Wetin the rush? I dey think. Give me till tomorrow make I decide.
Please send the account number, I will make the transfer this morning.
Boss, you no dey reply me since. Wetin happen? I dey ready to pay.
I want am. Make I pay half now, you go deliver, then I pay balance. Na so we dey do am here.
Will pay when I receive. That is my final decision. No argument.
Abeg give me small time. The money go enter before close of work today.
Boss, na the same thing my friend buy for [amount] for your store. Why you dey charge me more?
I dey think about am. How much be the deposit? If small I go pay now.
I dey save small small. Last price? When money reach, I go pay.
